audit.whatIsWrong: matchup-lint still reported MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / DISPLAY_ARTIFACT on irelia after the proposal pass; the original edits for these fields were rejected by the 10% length-drift rule, so the defects survived on disk.
audit.why: Pronouns come from champ-data/champ-gender.js; bleed bullets promise one thing in the title and paste the generic trade line in the body; a cooldowns field with no digit carries no information. Replacement cooldowns and interactions are taken from champ-data/_kits/irelia.json and champ-data/_kits/karma.json.
audit.corrected: The same corrections re-cut to fit inside the length-drift budget so that they actually apply.

edits.before: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
edits.after: Bladesurge costs 15 mana and heals per strike — break off when your 12s W root ends or she out-sustains the whole trade.

edits.before: No new ult — your 6 is a Mantra rank: faster cycles, bigger RQs. Press the early lead before scaling lanes wake up.
edits.after: Her 6 is Vanguard's Edge: it Marks you for a Bladesurge reset and walls off the retreat you have no dash to make.

edits.before: Ionian Fervor (R) gives Irelia a true-damage execute and tenacity that lets her force all-ins through your poke, flipping the level 6 window to her.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge (R) Marks you for a Bladesurge reset and drops a slowing wall across your retreat, flipping the level 6 window to her.

notes: QA lint-repair pass. Every after-string was length-checked against the on-disk before (<10% drift) and screened for elo tiers, non-interactions and filler before being written. Spell-shield, cleanse, QSS and tenacity behaviour is absent from the kit files (needsResearch is empty by design) and is asserted nowhere here.
